glosses: An instruction in a computer program, especially one that returns no value, as opposed to a function call.

examples.text: In this section we will examine BASIC's primary statement for repeating a string of statements under program control: the FOR statement. Another statement, the NEXT statement, is always used with a FOR statement.

glosses: That which is affirmed; a declaration that something is true.

examples.text: Her success was an affirmation of all her hard work.

glosses: A solemn pledge (to tell the truth, to bear allegiance, etc.), legally equivalent to an oath, taken by people who are forbidden to take a religious oath (such as Quakers) or otherwise prefer not to do so.

examples.text: Daily positive affirmations can improve self-confidence.

glosses: An emphatic or formal act of saying, telling or asserting something, by speech or writing; a decisive assertion or proclamation.

examples.text: The weather was not tempting enough to draw the two others from their pencil and their book, in spite of Marianne's declaration that the day would be lastingly fair […].

glosses: Specifically, a declaration of love.

examples.text: He blushed a great deal when the others chaffed him for his obvious preference. He made the first declaration in his life to Fräulein Hedwig, but unfortunately it was an accident […].
